event_records.description: The annual engagement survey opens for all 400 employees.

calloway_regional_hospital_employees.name: Calloway Regional Hospital employees
calloway_regional_hospital_employees.persona_brief:
You are Calloway Regional Hospital employees.
Each employee has their own workload, interest in the survey, and likelihood of completing it. No individual preferences are known at the start.

resolution.question: Will at least 60 of the 400 employees at Calloway Regional Hospital complete the annual engagement survey during its two-week window?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 60 distinct employees submitted a completed survey before 2026-09-15T17:00:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
